source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: lowest terms is settled by running 'Decide how to measure a quantity as a multiple count of a chosen': A quantity measured with fractional units is written by counting how many copies of the — on the item about Decide how to reduce a fraction to lowest terms by.

mx.name: operation_confusion
mx.teacher_note: Lowest terms is found by multiplying the given values instead of dividing, giving 41 as the reported result — on the item about Decide how to reduce a fraction to lowest terms by.

intelligence.enrichment: A fraction is in lowest terms when numerator and denominator have no common factor except 1; reducing divides both by a common factor, preferably the highest common factor.
